functions.name: Data models per product family
functions.description: The list of product families, each with its own attribute set (pim-build.json families[]). One attribute category and one data model per family, under a data-model folder in the DataStructure shop, with every product of the family related to its data model.

functions.name: Family attributes live in the family's data model, not in a global field
functions.description: Family attributes live in the family's data model, not in a global field. A global product field is a column on every product and an editor on every product's screen; an attribute only one family has belongs in that family's data model. Measured as the share of in-scope products that carry a value per custom global field.

notApplicable.when: at most one data model carries fields, so there is no second family a global field could be foreign to

functions.name: Data sets with inherited default values
functions.description: A sub-type inside a family whose products share fixed attribute values (a pack size, a series, a certification set), with those values named.

notApplicable.when: no family has a sub-type whose products share a fixed attribute value

functions.name: Typed fields: every attribute on the field type that fits its value
functions.description: The product data registry (pim-build.json attributes[]): every attribute with its kind. measure and decimal are Decimal, count is Integer, choice and multi-choice are List, flag is Checkbox, date is Date, text and code are Text, long-text is Long text, rich-text is Editor, link is Link, file is File, range is Range.

functions.name: Units on measures
functions.description: For every measure: the quantity (length, weight, volume, voltage, current, power, pressure, temperature, flow) and the unit the company states it in. One unit group per quantity with a base unit and the conversions the markets need; the unit set as the field's preset.

functions.name: Unit shown per language
functions.description: Which markets read metric and which read imperial, and the unit each language shows for each measure.

notApplicable.when: the build has one language
every language of the build belongs to a market on the same unit system

functions.name: List fields with options, single and multi select
functions.description: For every choice attribute: the closed list of options with a stable value and a display name; which attributes allow more than one option.

functions.name: Required fields
functions.description: Per family, the attributes a product may not be saved without (pim-build.json attributes[].required).

functions.name: Validation pattern on formatted codes
functions.description: A text attribute with a fixed format (a part number scheme, a HS code, a certificate number) and its pattern.

notApplicable.when: no text attribute of the catalogue has a fixed format

functions.name: Fields that differ per language or per variant
functions.description: Which attributes are translated (marketing text, application notes) and which differ between variants of one product (size, colour, rating).

notApplicable.when: the build has one language and no variants

functions.name: Computed fields (calculation or concatenation)
functions.description: A value derived from other fields: a dimension string, a converted figure, a generated title.

notApplicable.when: no attribute of the catalogue is derived from other attributes

functions.name: Field display groups
functions.description: How the specifications are grouped for a reader (Dimensions, Electrical, Certification), per family.

notApplicable.when: the build has no storefront and no feed

functions.name: Product numbers
functions.description: A unique item number per product and per variant.

functions.name: GTIN / EAN on the standard field
functions.description: The GTIN of every product traded through retail or marketplaces.

notApplicable.when: no channel of the company identifies products by barcode (direct industrial sales only)

functions.name: Manufacturers / brands
functions.description: The brands in the catalogue, each with a name and a logo, and the brand of every product.

notApplicable.when: every product is the company's own single brand and brand is not a filter

functions.name: Units of measure on products
functions.description: The units a product is sold in (each, box, pallet, metre) and the quantity per unit.

notApplicable.when: every product is sold by the piece and in no other unit

functions.name: Variants
functions.description: Products that exist in several orderable versions of one thing, the axis or axes that tell them apart (size, colour, voltage, length), the options on each axis and the item number of each combination.

notApplicable.when: no product of the catalogue exists in versions that differ only by an option

functions.name: Bundles and parts lists (BOM)
functions.description: Kits, assemblies or sets, each with its component products and quantities.

notApplicable.when: no product is sold as a set of other catalogue products and no parts list is published

functions.name: Product relations (accessories, spare parts, replacements)
functions.description: Per product: its accessories, its spare parts or consumables, and its successor when it is replaced; one relation group per kind.

notApplicable.when: no product of the catalogue is an accessory, spare part, consumable or successor of another

functions.name: Dynamic relations with amounts (materials, packaging, ingredients)
functions.description: Per product: the materials, packaging components or ingredients it is made of, each with an amount.

notApplicable.when: the company does not publish or report the composition or packaging of its products

functions.name: Product images with a default
functions.description: At least one image per product, one of them marked as the default.

functions.name: Documents in their own asset categories
functions.description: Per product: datasheet, manual or installation guide, certificate or declaration; one asset category per document kind with its file-type filter.

functions.name: Completeness rules per family
functions.description: Per family, the fields a product needs before it may be published.

functions.name: Product workflow with states, transitions and notifications
functions.description: The enrichment steps a product passes (for example Draft, Technical review, Approved), who is told at each step, and where each seeded product stands.

notApplicable.when: one person owns all product data and nothing is reviewed before publication

functions.name: Saved product queries (worklists)
functions.description: The questions the team asks of the catalogue: what is incomplete per family, what waits for review, what is in which channel, what lacks a translation.

functions.name: PIM dashboard with query-backed widgets
functions.description: The numbers the product manager watches: incomplete per family, waiting for review, missing translation, per channel.

functions.name: Dynamic workspaces
functions.description: The slices the team works in: by family, by brand, by a specification, by what is incomplete.

functions.name: PIM email notifications on a query
functions.description: Who is mailed when a worklist has rows (the enricher when products are incomplete, the reviewer when products wait).

notApplicable.when: one person owns all product data and nothing is reviewed before publication

functions.name: Field permissions per role
functions.description: The roles in the product team and the fields each may read or edit (pricing fields for pricing, technical fields for engineering).

notApplicable.when: one person owns all product data and nothing is reviewed before publication
every role of the product team may edit every field

functions.name: Product edit layout: a tab per family, shared tabs by a declared division, list presets
functions.description: A product edit layout an editor can work with: one tab per family, named after the product and carrying only that family's fields, so it shows on that family's products only; the fields every product shares on shared tabs divided one stated way (role, task, lifecycle or source, in the build's editLayout); at most 5 tabs on any product, groups an editor can scan, exactly one catch-all group; and list presets with the columns each role wants. One active layout applies to the product edit screen for every user.

notApplicable.when: at most one data model carries fields and it has at most 25 of them, so the stock Categories tab already is that one family's tab

functions.name: Channels with their own group tree
functions.description: The places product data goes (webshop, marketplace, dealer portal, print, a partner), and which products go to each.

functions.name: Feeds
functions.description: Per outgoing feed: the receiver, the format (JSON, XML, template), the products (a query, a channel or groups), the language and the fields.

functions.name: Assortments
functions.description: Which customers or customer groups may see which part of the catalogue, AND the range an anonymous visitor may see. One active assortment switches access control on for every visitor of every shop: a visitor with no assortment sees no product. So the anonymous assortment that covers the public range is created, related and built first, and only then is anything activated.

notApplicable.when: every buyer may see every published product

functions.name: Product assignment rules (auto-assign to groups)
functions.description: The rule that places a product in a channel group: a query, or an attribute value per group.

notApplicable.when: the catalogue is small enough to place by hand

functions.name: Translations of products, field labels and list options
functions.description: The languages of the markets served; translated name and description per product; translated field labels and list option names.

notApplicable.when: the company sells in one language

functions.name: Data Integration activity for the product load
functions.description: The source the product rows come from (an ERP export, a supplier sheet) and its mapping to product fields.

notApplicable.when: the catalogue is small enough to seed without an import

functions.name: Grid editing
functions.description: Inventory omission recovered; baseline support and observable behaviour require measurement.

functions.description: Inventory omission recovered; baseline support and observable behaviour require measurement.

functions.description: Inventory omission recovered; baseline support and observable behaviour require measurement.

functions.description: Inventory omission recovered; baseline support and observable behaviour require measurement.

functions.description: Inventory omission recovered; baseline support and observable behaviour require measurement.

functions.description: Inventory omission recovered; baseline support and observable behaviour require measurement.

functions.description: Inventory omission recovered; baseline support and observable behaviour require measurement.

functions.description: Inventory omission recovered; baseline support and observable behaviour require measurement.

functions.description: Inventory omission recovered; baseline support and observable behaviour require measurement.

functions.name: Automatic product numbering
functions.description: Inventory omission recovered; baseline support and observable behaviour require measurement.

functions.name: Range fields
functions.description: Inventory omission recovered; baseline support and observable behaviour require measurement.

functions.name: Matrix fields
functions.description: Store a product attribute as a typed table with declared columns, rows and source values.

functions.name: JSON feed provider
functions.description: Publish a configured PIM feed with the JSON provider.

functions.name: Attribute translation state
functions.description: Show translation states for standard, global and category attribute definitions.

functions.name: Import key detection
functions.description: Detect primary keys when preparing a PIM import.

functions.name: Documents per language or market
functions.description: A product document that applies to one language or market only: the asset row carries a language (EcomDetails.DetailLanguageId), and another language of the same product shows a different file in the same asset category (for example a manual per unit system).

functions.name: Document metadata: version and history
functions.description: Per document asset: a version label (EcomDetails.DetailVersion), validity dates and whether older versions are shown in history. The publication type is the asset category (pim.documents); the language of a document is pim.document-scope.

functions.name: Image alt text per language
functions.description: Alt text (caption) per product image, stored as the asset name (EcomDetails.DetailsName, the name the MCP image tools describe as alt text or caption); a language-specific asset row carries the translated text.

functions.name: Product videos
functions.description: Video assets next to images and documents: a file detail with a video extension (mp4, m4v, mov, webm, mkv, ogv, avi, the formats the MCP video tools accept) or a link detail in a LinkSelector asset category.

functions.name: Units with an offset conversion (temperature)
functions.description: A unit that converts with an offset as well as a factor, such as degrees Fahrenheit in a temperature group. On 10.29.8 a unit conversion stores one factor (EcomFieldValueConversion.FieldValueConversionFactor) and no offset, so the platform cannot store this conversion.

functions.name: Secondary unit and fraction display
functions.description: A measure shown with a secondary unit next to its preset unit (5.60 in (143 mm)) or an imperial length shown as a fraction (3/4). The stored field settings have a display rule of Fixed or Automatic only; the format is produced by a template or feed.

functions.name: Relations with attribute values
functions.description: A relation between two products that carries its own typed values, such as a battery and charger pair with minutes to 80 and 100 percent. Product relations (EcomProductsRelated) carry group, sort order and limits only; dynamic relations carry one amount.

functions.name: Structured feature blocks
functions.description: A repeatable, translated feature block per product (title, text, bullet, image) rendered as feature cards. No platform carrier is established: matrix columns on 10.29.8 allow text, number, link and list types but not a file, and an item-type field for products is not measured.
